title: Week of September 28, 2026
summary: A late-week edition for the Oct. 2–4 weekend, built around Lewes Maritime Weekend: Boast the Coast fills the canalfront Saturday, 11 a.m.–2 p.m., and UD's free Coast Day marks its 50th year Sunday, 10 a.m.–3 p.m., at the Hugh R. Sharp Campus. Sidewalk sales run through Sunday in Lewes and Rehoboth, the Cape Henlopen hawk watch continues through November, and October brings Apple-Scrapple, True Blue Jazz and Sea Witch's Community Fair and costume parade on Oct. 23–24.
hiddenGemNote: No new Hidden Gem was published this week.

dailySlots.headline: Sidewalk sales bookend the coast this weekend
dailySlots.note: Lewes merchants and the Rehoboth–Dewey resort area both run fall sidewalk sales Oct. 2–4, and Delaware Botanic Gardens in Dagsboro offers guided Welcome Walks at 10 a.m. on Oct. 2 and 3.

dailySlots.headline: Boast the Coast opens Lewes Maritime Weekend
dailySlots.note: Lewes Maritime Weekend starts today at 1812 Park and the City Dock on the canalfront, 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. It's free: Freedom Boat Club canal tours, live music from Jgar, kids' entertainment and free admission to the Cannonball House. A one-hour narrated history cruise with Cape Water Tours is the one paid extra.

dailySlots.headline: Fifty years of Coast Day
dailySlots.note: Coast Day turns 50 today. The University of Delaware opens its Hugh R. Sharp Campus in Lewes from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m., free, for hands-on marine science, live demonstrations, and lab and ship tours. Fifth graders can still enter the essay contest on Delaware's habitats and ecosystems through Oct. 9.

editorialNotes: W40 published 2026-10-02, four days into the week, as a late-week edition for Oct. 2–4. Daily slots for Sept. 28 – Oct. 1 were not published because those days had passed. Coast Day hours, free admission and 50th year confirmed against University of Delaware sources 2026-10-02. Unverified items were held back; see editorialHolds in automation/candidates/candidate-2026-09-27.json. First-party-ingested events were reused rather than duplicated. No story was published with this issue.
